hero.title: Stainless Steel Cutlery & Kitchen Utensils Manufacturer
hero.description: Based in Jieyang, China. We manufacture stainless steel cutlery and kitchen utensils for wholesalers, importers and private-label buyers.

story.title: Manufacturing in Jieyang since {businessStartYear}
paragraphs: Yumingxing’s brand and factory operations began in {businessStartYear} in Jieyang, Guangdong, China. Our focus is stainless steel cutlery and kitchen utensils.
We supply knives, forks, spoons and kitchen tools for international wholesalers, importers and private-label buyers. Material, dimensions, finish, branding and packaging are agreed for each order.
From material selection and forming to polishing, customization, inspection and packing, the process starts with a clear product specification and an approved sample.
story.imageAlt: Yumingxing factory entrance in Jieyang, Guangdong, China

story.title: 始于{businessStartYear}年的制造业务
paragraphs: 裕明兴的品牌及工厂业务始于{businessStartYear}年，位于广东省揭阳市，专注不锈钢餐具与厨房用具。
我们为国际批发商、进口商和自有品牌采购商提供刀、叉、勺及厨房工具。材质、尺寸、表面处理、标识与包装均按具体订单确认。
从原料选择、冲压成型到表面处理、定制、检验与包装，以清晰的产品规格和确认样品衔接各道工序。
